ideas.name: flip1 with the day's direction
ideas.why: the mirror of the warnings' result: flips that go with where the session has gone since the open join the drift

ideas.name: flip1 within 10 min of a 5m flip its way
ideas.why: a 1m flip right after the 5m box turned the same way is the fast timeframe confirming a new slower trend

ideas.name: flip held for a second bar
ideas.why: a flip still standing one bar later has survived the first whipsaw; entering a bar late trades a little price for fewer false flips

ideas.name: flip1 breaking the 30-minute range
ideas.why: a flip that also takes out the last 30 minutes' high (low) is a breakout, not a wiggle inside a range

ideas.name: flip1 with both rows crossing within 3 bars
ideas.why: both lines crossing almost together is a sharp change; one row crossing long before the other is a slow drift
